svg.text: JW-SAK-POP-01 / REV A / 23 OCT 2026 / A3 at 100% / profiles 1:2
SHELF MOUNT: 2 small tape tabs. Top of card 7.5 mm below deck; no aisle stalk.

No discount or limited-stock claim. Crayon text stays within the inner safe area.
CAD profiles in mm, model space 1:1. Shelf positions in the placement JSON. Candidate branch only.
